decisive_items: lytic lesion of the frontal bone with a soap-bubble appearance
cortical destruction of the inner and outer tables
response.rationale: R6 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including the soap-bubble appearance and cortical destruction, which are characteristic of Giant Cell Tumors. R1 is the runner-up because it also has strong support from the vignette, but the absence of adjacent soft-tissue swelling and the presence of a soap-bubble appearance make R6 a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: lack of ground-glass appearance and limited support from the vignette
osteoma is less likely due to the presence of cortical destruction and a soap-bubble appearance
Ewing's Sarcoma is less likely due to the absence of systemic symptoms and the presence of a well-circumscribed mass
Eosinophilic Granuloma is less likely due to the absence of systemic symptoms and the presence of cortical destruction
less comprehensive support than R6 and lack of independent assessment
